summary: Iteration 10 — Verified the follow-up fixes after iteration 9's CRITICAL migration bug + export regression. db_seeder.py line 214 now includes `avoid_staff_pairs` AND `weekend_off_per_rota` in the migration tuple, both rules are now present in live rules_config. Excel export has print_area bounded ($A$1:$AC$11 on Rota, dedicated Summary print_area), fitToHeight=1, fitToWidth=1, verticalCentered=True. PDF row heights now scale from page_h/n_staff (28-62pt clamp) and the table fills >45% of page height. 12/13 iteration10 pytest PASS; solver/test_runner.py passes 28/28 [OK]; frontend smoke across Rules/Settings/Requests/Staff/RequestLink all render correctly. ONE SOFT-RULE CONCERN (non-blocking): weekend_off_per_rota with soft+weight=50 leaves 3 of 7 active staff (T.D., A.A., J.R.) without a full Sat+Sun off across the 4-week rota — likely low weight vs. competing hard constraints. Likely needs a higher default weight or hard-mode toggle if spec requires 100% compliance.

minor.issue: 3/7 active staff (T.D., A.A., J.R.) got zero full Sat+Sun OFF across 4 weeks. Soft rule is being traded off. Consider raising default weight from 50 to 150+ or offering Hard mode. Not a code bug per se — solver is correctly treating it as soft.

issues: Still reads 'Phase 2 · v0.3.0' — carry-over from iteration 7/9, cosmetic.
